# Frozen Go CLI oracle

`cli-go-c320fc7.json` was generated by running `freeze-go-oracle.go.txt`
against the unmodified `apps/server-agent` at c320fc7100c32b37118c7c210bf7815811614bb5,
with its linked Rust core. It records stdout, stderr and exit codes before
removing the Go CLI. The original implementation and tests are retained as
non-compiling historical inputs. Do not regenerate the expected output from
the Rust implementation. The Rust subprocess tests also migrate the original
admin, validation and private-storage tests; random secret invitations are
validated in memory and never included in snapshots or failure messages.

`admin-go-c320fc7.json` was generated with `freeze-admin-go-oracle.go.txt`
against those same original sources in a temporary package. Only the temporary
directory and today's approval date were replaced with `<DIR>`/`<DATE>`;
all other bytes and exit codes are frozen. Both files together cover 45 cases.
